title: Private Photoshoot in Boston
includes: Capture unforgettable memories with professional photos taken at Boston’s iconic landmarks
Explore Boston on a private tour with a personal photographer
Receive all high-resolution, professionally edited photos taken during your session
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
You don’t need to know how to pose, the photographer will help you with that throughout the session.

You’ll be guided with posing suggestions, flattering angles, and photo references to make sure you get beautiful pictures and feel confident in front of the camera.

You’ll also receive all photos taken during the session, plus at least 8 edited photos that are ready for social media.
